verdicts.note: Self-reference 'the only girl in the class' confirms female.
Comprehensive school, and confirms 'No' to all-girls' = mixed sex.
Subject is a D&T student throughout; context confirms Design & Technology.
'I do actually enjoy the work... something that I enjoy doing' supports interesting work.
'several aspects, you're not just stuck doing one thing... loads of things' maps directly to varied.
Brother 'doing the same thing' = family member involved in the field.
Galleries/Art & Design family outings are not the subject's own TECHNICAL hobbies; item requires technical-nature hobbies. Reject.
Teacher 'talked to me about the background' is informational rather than explicit encouragement; downgrade to medium.
'other than that, not really' = no careers-advisor encouragement, supports disagree.
Quote 'Not really, no. I didn't mind' answers whether male-domination BOTHERED her, not discouragement; no discouragement was ever probed. Reject.
Despite slight regret, 'I do actually enjoy the work that we do' affirms pleased with choice.
Covered things 'in as much depth' than she was aware leans to more-than-expected; thin, medium retained.
Group work develops ability to 'communicate with other people' = interpersonal skills.
'really good tutor so I'm quite happy' = satisfied with personal tutor.
'I do like doing group work' with caveats = satisfied (not very satisfied).
Quote is about 'the work' generally, not design work specifically, but design is the core of her course; thin, medium retained.
'No I'm not' to doing the placement.
'difficult to get back into the flow... don't want to get out of the uni system' directly supports fear-of-return-after-break.
Sees limited gain from others' experience, but qualifies it 'depends'; thin, medium retained.
Only brief office work, no relevant work experience, so the 'already have work experience' reason does not apply = disagree; inferential, medium retained.
'I will go into the design industry' = design work.
'prefer to go into more management' = managerial.
'required to do a bit of further training' indirectly supports yes; framed as required, medium retained.
'I want a well paid job' = salary important.
'not really too bothered about' location = unimportant.
'type of work I'm going to do' is the CONTENT of the work, not the work ENVIRONMENT the item asks about. Reject.
'wouldn't mind if there weren't any... but then after...' = ambivalent = neither important nor unimportant.
